description.intro: The Manchester City Authentic 26 27 Puma T-shirt is the version used by footballers of the club citizen in official matches. Designed to deliver maximum performance, it incorporates lightweight materials and advanced technologies that favor perspiration and comfort during play.
key_benefits: Authentic Version: Same technology and finishes used by professional players.
ULTRAWEAVE Technology: Evacuate sweat to maintain comfort.
Light fabric: Promotes ventilation and freedom of movement.
Official design Manchester City: Inspired by the citizen legacy.
